title: Doppler configuration governance implementation tasks
principles: Doppler governs operator-set credentials and related environment identities, not host, GitHub, Alchemy-internal or evidence-derived values.
Start with one small local and Quality vertical slice, then extend the same narrow boundary to Preview and Production.
Use fixed project/config selection, no ambient Doppler config, no Doppler fallback, no Bun or Alchemy env-file loading, named GitHub action outputs and exact consumer-step scope.
Keep secret values and transformed values out of source, logs, caches, artifacts, receipts and review evidence.
Preserve the native Alchemy resource, stage, state, lock, plan, teardown, readback, hosted-proof and recovery design.
Treat provider and credential changes as separate operations under docs/operations/authority-model.md.
Keep ordinary application development and fork Quality credential-free.
Do not add a Changeset because no installed package behaviour or export changes.
beforeImplementation: Complete and record the repository-local PRD review before changing runtime, workflow or tool source.
Reconfirm the exact TaxKit HEAD, origin/main, pinned Bun version, Doppler CLI version and immutable GitHub action SHAs.

Re-read docs/architecture/configuration.md, docs/architecture/deployment.md, docs/architecture/effect-services.md, docs/architecture/testing-and-quality.md, docs/operations/authority-model.md and the deployment runbooks.
Do not create a Doppler project/config, import a value, create/rotate/revoke a token, change a GitHub secret or run provider mutation without a separately approved exact operation envelope.
Preserve unrelated work and do not rewrite historical evidence.

globalVerification.commitPolicy: Commit each coherent accepted slice after its focused checks, full repository verification, documentation review and no-Changeset rationale. Do not merge while required external bootstrap or hosted checks remain unproved.
requiredBeforeFinalPR: bun run changeset status --verbose and explicit repository-internal no-Changeset rationale
evidenceRequired: Exact final local and GitHub call graphs reconciled against package.json, workflows and policies.
Fixed Doppler project/config selection, ambient credential stripping, no fallback, named secret allowlists, and Bun and Alchemy env-file loading disabled.
Separate local dev_<user> stack-stage decoding without widening the pr-N/prod deployment and evidence stage.
Trusted Quality named-output path and complete fork credential-free path.
Preview and Production isolation across Doppler config, GitHub environment, Alchemy stage and credential scope.
Typed missing/malformed configuration failure before provider work and redacted Effect/Alchemy secret handling.
Secret-negative logs, cache paths and allowlisted artifact tests using deterministic sentinel values.
Native Alchemy resource, state, lock, plan/replan, readback, teardown, hosted and recovery contracts unchanged.
Current documentation, runbooks, automation register, SPEC/task ledger and execution plan updated in the same slices.
Exact external operation envelope, receipts and non-claims for any separately approved provider work.
No-Changeset rationale for repository workflow, tool and maintainer-document changes.

downstreamArtifactImpact.surface: Canonical architecture, operations, runbooks and relevant READMEs
Root scripts, GitHub workflows, workflow policies, fixtures, cache and evidence adapters
App runtime, API, SDK, calculators, React UI, package exports, generators, migrations, skills and lint language rules
downstreamArtifactImpact.decision: N/A with path evidence in the SPEC
N/A because installed package behaviour and exports do not change

tasks.title: Prove the fixed local Doppler boundary
tasks.goal: Add one deterministic local credentialed docs path while keeping ordinary development and the internal Alchemy command source-neutral.
scope: Add a fixed root adapter/internal script for taxkit/dev using ambient Doppler/provider stripping, --no-read-env, --no-fallback, --no-check-version, --only-secrets and Bun --no-env-file.
Use a committed intentionally empty Alchemy env-file input so the internal command cannot load a developer .env.
Add a separate Schema-owned dev_<user> stack stage while keeping DocsDeploymentStage strictly pr-N or prod.
Keep bun run dev credential-free and preserve Portless/host-owned values.
Add deterministic fake-Doppler tests for exact arguments, named injection, missing auth/config and no fallback or env-file use.
Document scoped login, a pass/fail-only keyring custody check, expected failure and local recovery without values; forbid doppler configure debug.
Update canonical configuration/deployment docs, root README, docs app README, SPEC ledger and active plan.
Add Doppler to tool allowlists such as Knip only where the real command requires it.
outputs: tools/docs-deployment/* focused local adapter, custody, empty-env, policy and test files
tasks.implementationPrompt: Implement only DCG-001. Read the SPEC, this task, current package.json, Alchemy stage/config owners, docs configuration/deployment owners, docs app README and runbook before editing. Preserve the native Alchemy command behind a source-neutral internal script, but repair its current default dev_<user> rejection with a separate local stack-stage Schema that does not widen DocsDeploymentStage. Use exact fixed Doppler arguments, strip ambient bridge/provider values, disable Bun and Alchemy env-file loading, and add deterministic fake-process and pass/fail-only custody proof; do not contact a provider or inspect or print a secret. Review the diff against strict Effect, Alchemy IaC, repository structure and documentation rules. Report final call graph, checks, no-Changeset rationale and any authority stop.
mandatoryVerification: focused local wrapper and docs-deployment policy tests
deterministic fake Doppler success, missing-auth/config, ambient-value stripping, named-secret, no-read-env, no-fallback and no-env-file tests
focused dev_<user> positive tests and negative proof that deployment/evidence stages still reject dev stages
pass/fail-only Doppler custody tests that never include a stored value in output
qualityAudits: Confirm the adapter has one fixed project/config owner, strips ambient governed values and keeps the internal Alchemy command source-neutral.
Confirm no raw environment parser, secret value, fallback file, Bun/Alchemy .env dependency, shell argument token, debug-token output or unnecessary helper/framework was added.

completionCriteria: The fixed local command fails closed and can run the existing internal Alchemy command with only approved names.

tasks.title: Move Quality and receipt inputs to named Doppler outputs
tasks.goal: Use the immutable Doppler action for trusted CI while preserving a full credential-free fork path and secret-free cache ordering.
scope: Update Quality and receipt reconciliation workflows to fetch taxkit/ci through repository DOPPLER_CI_TOKEN only after all cache saves.
Keep DOPPLER_CI_TOKEN step-local to the fetch, verify safe project/config metadata and map only required named outputs to exact consumer steps.
Keep fork pull requests on the complete credential-free path without a fetch attempt.
Remove direct active TURBO_TOKEN/TURBO_TEAM reads from new workflow source without deleting the retained legacy GitHub values.
Prepare an allowlisted receipt upload directory so downloaded source artifacts and raw GitHub API responses are not re-uploaded.
Update workflow policy, fixtures, setup-bun version comments, automation register and operational docs.
tasks.implementationPrompt: Implement only DCG-002 after DCG-001 acceptance. Preserve complete fork Quality with local Turbo caching. Use repository DOPPLER_CI_TOKEN, the exact Doppler action SHA, no broad injection, safe taxkit/ci metadata checks and named Turbo outputs on exact consumers after every cache save. Prepare only the bounded final receipt or failure file for upload. Do not create or change GitHub/Doppler secrets. Extend current workflow policy owners instead of adding a new framework. completionCriteria: Trusted CI has one named-output Doppler path and forks have no credential path.

Preserve pr-<number> stage locks, native Alchemy plan/replan/deploy, hosted proof and exact-stage teardown.
Replace broad runner-directory artifact uploads with a prepared allowlisted upload directory.
Add deterministic secret-sentinel, forbidden-file and raw-output negative tests that report names only.
Update deployment workflow policies, automation register, architecture, operations, runbooks, SPEC ledger and active plan.

tasks.title: Bootstrap, prove, clean up and close out
tasks.goal: Perform only the separately approved provider operation, prove the merged path at exact identity, remove legacy custody under separate approval, and close the plan without overstating proof.
scope: Present and obtain approval for the exact principal/resource/environment/change/rollback/readback envelope before provider mutation.

Create only approved missing Doppler resources and three read-only expiring single-config service tokens for ci, stg_preview and prd, then set only repository DOPPLER_CI_TOKEN and the separate Preview/Production environment DOPPLER_PROVIDER_TOKEN bridges; dev remains personal-login-only.
Run exact-SHA trusted Quality, fork fallback, Preview/deploy/hosted/teardown, Production/rollback/redeploy and receipt proof as authorised.
Inspect uploaded artifacts and cache ordering for secret-negative proof without reading values.
After merged-main proof and separate approval, remove direct Turbo/Cloudflare GitHub values and retired report-only credential entries, then read back metadata absence.
Reconcile exact origin/main identity, move the plan to completed, mark the SPEC/task ledger implemented and record receipts, limits and non-claims.
outputs: approved provider operation record or a bounded pending-authority record
exact hosted workflow and provider readback identities
